_comment: MULTI-BLOG click routing (2026-08-08). Copy this to /data/blogs.json on the VPS (the persistent volume) and edit. Map each TRACKING host (the go.<blog> subdomain the app publishes, and that you DNS-point at this VPS) to that blog's real destination ORIGIN. Editing this file needs NO redeploy (it is mtime-cached). Alternatively set the same JSON as the CLICK_BLOGS env var. Keys are hosts, values are origins (scheme+host).
